hero.title: VoiceStick
hero.lead: A compact voice stick based on M5Stack StickS3. It connects to macOS or Windows over BLE, uses the Doubao speech foundation model for recognition, and turns real-time feedback into text at your cursor.
hero.imageAlt: VoiceStick portable voice input device based on M5Stack StickS3

ble.title: Low-power BLE
ble.body: Pair the StickS3 in your hand over Bluetooth Low Energy. It is wireless, efficient, and ready to stay on your desk or travel with your laptop.

model.title: Doubao speech foundation model
model.body: VoiceStick uses the Doubao speech foundation model for recognition, making spoken Chinese, longer sentences, and everyday phrasing feel fast to turn into editable text.

feedback.title: Live text feedback
feedback.body: Recognition appears as live feedback on screen, then the final text is confirmed before it is inserted into the current input field.

story.title: Pick it up to speak. Put it down to keep writing.
story.body: VoiceStick turns M5Stack StickS3 into a dedicated voice input button. Keep it near your keyboard, slip it into a pocket, or carry it with your laptop. Hold to talk, and the recognized text comes back to your cursor.

flasher.title: Flash firmware online
flasher.body: Use desktop Chrome or Edge to flash your M5Stack StickS3 or VoiceStick C3 v1 over USB.

steps.usb: Connect your {board} to your computer with a USB-C data cable.
steps.flash: Click Start flashing and choose the device’s USB serial port.

boot.stick_s3: If the connection fails, hold the side reset button until the internal green LED blinks, then release it and try again.
boot.voicestick_c3: If the connection fails, hold the cancel (BOOT) button while restarting the device. Release it once the device enters download mode, then try again.

flasher.unsupported: This browser does not support Web Serial. Open this page in desktop Chrome or Edge.

log.selectPort: Waiting for USB serial port selection...
log.done: Flashing complete. A reset signal was sent to the device.

error.manifestUnavailable: Could not load the firmware manifest for the selected model.
error.wrongChip: Detected {chip}. The selected {board} uses {expected}. Check the model and serial port, then try again.
